blocks.text: if statement se hum shart (condition) ki bunyaad par faisla karte hain. Agar shart sach (True) ho to code ka ek block chalta hai; jhoot (False) ho to woh block chhor diya jata hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab syntax mein "If condition:" bare I ke saath chhapti hai. Python ke keywords chhote letters mein hote hain: if condition:. Bare I se SyntaxError aata hai.
Misaal: agar temperature 30 degree se zyada ho to paighaam print karein.

Yahan temperature = 35 hai, to shart temperature > 30 sach hai aur "It’s a hot day" print hota hai. Dhyan dein: print wali line aage khiski hui (indented) hai; isi se Python samajhti hai ke yeh line if ke andar hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar temperature 25 ho to program kya print karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Kuch nahi: shart jhooti hai, to block chhor diya jata hai.

items: if shart: shart sach ho to indented block chalta hai.
Keyword hamesha chhote letters mein: if.
